scope: All distributed files and every reachable Git commit/blob; ignored local verification/build artifacts are excluded from distribution.
limits: Pattern and known-value checks are not a proof of absence of all sensitive material or of dataset redistribution rights. No external datasets/checkpoints are distributed.

git_history.stage: Snapshot of history and working files at validation time; the resulting commit is checked again before push.

naming.compatibility: Legacy namespace, configuration paths, protocol IDs, hashes and result fields are retained.

skipped_integration_tests.reason: Set DOFAV2_OFFICIAL_REPO and DOFAV2_OFFICIAL_CHECKPOINT for the real compatibility test.
CUDA is required to verify the real wrapped-model migration contract.
TerraTorch CLI integration test requires the frozen TerraTorch runtime.
Real TerraTorch dataset construction requires TerraTorch and rasterio.
Set RSFM_RUN_TERRAMIND_GPU_INTEGRATION=1 with real Sen1 paths to run the GPU fast-dev regression.
Exact TerraTorch callback integration requires the frozen Colab runtime.
